verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents a broad first-party API covering the core domain lifecycle: search, registration, DNS, WHOIS contacts, registry lock, renewals, forwarding, transfers and auctions. It also offers Commerce APIs and an OpenAPI spec. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and much of what the UI offers, such as hosting, email, website builder and SSL, appears nowhere in the API docs. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage of non-domain UI products (hosting, email, site builder, SSL), independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
